commands.reanimation.execution.list.head: Executions:
execution.reanimation.coup_de_grace.desc: He slowly lifts him above his head, smashes him into the ground hard enough to crack the earth, then finishes him with a kick to the head.
execution.reanimation.frappe_orbitale.de: He raises his arm to the sky: a laser locks onto the target. He turns his back and walks away as an orbital beam obliterates it.
execution.reanimation.chute_meteore.desc: A ten-meter leap with a backflip, then he crashes onto his victim like a meteor, in the middle of a crater.
execution.reanimation.combo_aerien.desc: A charged uppercut launches him into the air, he jumps up after him and slams him back down with a two-handed hammer blow.
execution.reanimation.arrache_ame.desc: He plunges his hand into the chest, rips out the soul as he lifts him, then crushes it between his hands.
execution.reanimation.mille_coupes.desc: A katana drawn from a rift, he teleports from cut to cut on the beat: every slash hangs in the air. He sheathes it with his back turned... and at the click of the guard, everything explodes.
execution.reanimation.singularite.desc: A black dot forms in his palm and becomes a black hole above the body: the ground is pulled in, the body lifted, stretched, wrung out. His fist closes: implosion.
execution.reanimation.courroux_ciel.desc: The sky darkens, lightning strikes around the body on every beat, the current from his hands lifts it. His hand comes down: a colossal bolt pins it to the ground.
execution.reanimation.souffle_dragon.des: A kung-fu kata to the drums, then a dragon of flames bursts from his chest, coils around the body, rises to the sky... and dives right through it.
execution.reanimation.zero_absolu.desc: A heel stomp freezes the ground, a block of ice grows around the body on every beat. He takes a run-up: a jumping spin kick shatters the statue.
execution.reanimation.danse_ombres.desc: Four shadows break away from him and juggle the body, hit after hit, higher and higher. On the drop, they all strike at once.
execution.reanimation.main_joker.desc: Cascade shuffle, fan, then he throws his cards right past the body pinned to a target. The ace of spades goes last: straight through the heart.
execution.reanimation.faille.desc: He draws a circle: a rift opens under the body, another in the sky. An endless fall, faster and faster... until he closes the ground.
execution.reanimation.onde_celeste.desc: Night falls with a gesture. The body rises, arms spread; on every beat he touches it and a star lights up, linked to the last, the same giant constellation in the sky. He tears a shooting star from it: straight to the heart, supernova.
execution.reanimation.apesanteur.desc: Palm to the sky, gravity vanishes: rocks, dust and body float in orbit. His fist slams down and everything falls at once, ten times heavier.
execution.reanimation.marionnettiste.des: Suspended in the air, he ties threads of light to the wrists, ankles and head, and makes him dance to the beat. Then he cuts the strings.
execution.reanimation.freestyle_combo.de: Lifted by the collar, boxed to the rhythm: jabs, hooks, uppercut, elbow, knee. The record scratches, everything slows down: jumping spin heel kick.
execution.reanimation.tempete_sakura.des: He throws a seed behind the body: a cherry tree shoots up on every beat, its branches bind the body and hoist it against the trunk. Full bloom… then the flowers drink and turn red. He clenches his fist: the tree bursts into a storm of red petals.
execution.reanimation.tag_final.desc: He shakes his spray can to the beat and tags R.I.P under the body. The tag lights up in neon, pulses with the music... the thrown can explodes on it.
execution.reanimation.jugement_runique.d: Four rune circles, chains of light that hoist him up arms outstretched, and a giant sword of light that descends from the sky to pin him to the ground.
execution.reanimation.cadeau_surprise.de: A giant gift falls from the sky onto the body, the ribbons tie themselves, the box shakes and hops to the rhythm. He pulls the bow: confetti.
execution.reanimation.sucre_d_orge.desc: A giant candy cane wielded like a staff, the crook hooking the body, a hammer throw in the snow, and the candy cane planted like a javelin.
He rolls snowballs around the body: carrot, coal, buttons, scarf, top hat. Then he takes a run-up: jumping kick.
execution.reanimation.lames_fantomes.des: With his own knife: he vanishes and reappears from cut to cut on the beat, every slash hangs in the air. Back turned, he throws the knife over his shoulder and catches it behind his back: everything explodes.
execution.reanimation.pantin.desc: He throws his knife into the sky; as it falls, threads of light turn the body into a puppet that dances and hits itself. Arms outstretched, head raised... the knife plunges into the skull, and he falls in slow motion.
execution.reanimation.karambit.desc: The karambit spins on his finger, the hook tears up the back to the nape, then slams down like a hammer into the temple.
execution.reanimation.sea_gleam.desc: Lifted with one hand, beheaded with a single Sea Gleam swing.
execution.reanimation.butterfly.desc: A balisong show, the blade open before his eyes, thrown high and driven into the nape in slow motion.
execution.reanimation.m9.desc: Flipped over with a kick, he holds back the blade with both hands while his heart races... until he lets go.
execution.reanimation.home_run.desc: A pillory built in three wooden strikes, and the head flies off like a baseball.
